personality: 3 Editorial Mobile LIGHT with tactile Autumn accents
personality_one_liner: A warm, personal digital cookbook that feels like a beautifully lit autumnal kitchen, designed for hands-free culinary focus.

spacing.rule: Generous, editorial whitespace. Let the typography and food photography breathe. Use tight spacing inside metadata clusters, but large spacing between sections.

do's: Use glass on the bottom tab bar to let recipe images glide underneath.
Use glass on the sticky 'Start Cooking' CTA container.
Use subtle glass over dark gradient scrims for hero card titles.
dont's: Do not use glass heavily on dense ingredient lists.
Avoid glass in Cookist Mode to ensure maximum high-contrast readability from a distance.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: A personalized culinary dashboard that invites users to start cooking or discover new ideas.

states.empty: Illustration of an empty wooden cutting board, 'Your kitchen is waiting', primary CTA 'Find a recipe'.
states.error: Message 'Couldn't load your kitchen', Retry button.

screens.layout: Header: 'Good morning, Cookist' (Fraunces serif) + Profile avatar. Main Action: Large 'What's cooking today?' card with warm golden/terracotta gradient. Sections (Horizontal scrolling): 'Recommended for you' (Image cards), 'What's in my kitchen?' (AI generator entry point), 'Recent recipes'. Generous xl vertical spacing between sections.

screens.name: Recipe Detail
screens.purpose: Showcase the recipe beautifully with progressive disclosure before committing to cook.

states.loading: Skeleton loaders for image and text rows.

screens.layout: Full-bleed hero image at the top with a top-to-bottom gradient scrim (transparent to surfaceInverse 70%). Recipe title (Fraunces 2xl) sits on the image. Below image (surface): Prep/Cook/Serves metadata in a clean row. Clean ingredients list with border bottom dividers. Sticky bottom container (glass or solid surface) with a large 'Start Cooking' (Cookist Mode) CTA.

screens.name: Cookist Mode (Active Cooking)
screens.purpose: A hands-free, high-contrast, distraction-free voice cooking assistant usable from a distance.
screens.layout: Dark theme override for high contrast (surfaceInverse #3E2723 background). Single-step focus. Huge step typography (DM Sans 3xl, onSurfaceInverse text). Voice listening indicator (subtle glowing animation in brandSecondary). Giant tap targets for 'Next'/'Back' as fallback to voice. Inline timer chip.

screens.name: What's in my kitchen? (AI Generator)
screens.purpose: Allow users to input ingredients and get personalized recipe recommendations.

states.loading: Lottie of a bubbling pot or animated 'Thinking...' with culinary puns.
states.empty: Enter up to 5 ingredients to get started.

screens.layout: Search/input bar at top. Tag cloud of suggested ingredients (brandTertiary chips). Generate button pinned to bottom.

screens.name: Owami+ Paywall
screens.purpose: A premium, beautiful native paywall to upgrade to Owami+.
screens.layout: Cinematic full-screen image background (Autumn rustic kitchen) with 80% surfaceInverse gradient scrim. Premium typography (Fraunces). Feature list with Phosphor checkmarks. Large 'Upgrade to Owami+' CTA.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette. No blues, purples, or generic greens. The palette is built around warm autumn tones: Espresso, Terracotta, Cream, Chestnut.
Use Fraunces (serif) for headings and recipe titles, and DM Sans (sans-serif) for body text and metadata. Cap font weights at 500.
Implement the gradient scrim pattern for ALL images that have text overlaid on them (e.g., Recipe Detail hero images).

For the 'Cookist Mode', create a distinct high-contrast experience using the 'surfaceInverse' (#3E2723) background. The UI here should feature massively upscaled typography (3xl) and oversized touch targets to ensure it is usable hands-free from a distance.
Apply 'expo-blur' glassmorphism safely over the bottom tab bar and sticky 'Start Cooking' CTAs to achieve the premium 'modern cookbook' feel, gracefully degrading on low-end Androids.
